Issued 13 September 2023; Official Gazette No. 759 (supplement) of 15 September 2023; in force 16 September 2023 (Art. 27: the day after publication). Art. 2 defines trafficking, including forced labour and forced service; Art. 3 victim consent irrelevant; Art. 11 offence of hiding or destroying the victim's documents; Art. 23 victim protection; Art. 24-25 National Committee to Combat Human Trafficking. Art. 26(1) repeals Federal Law 51/2006.
